title: Susan Gough refuses to amend statement to include non-human intelligence

tellings.quote: As speaking of Sean Kurpatre, I'm reminded to when Susan Go was asked if by a foyer researcher or somebody if they could amend her statement about no extraterrestrials to include non-human intelligence,

plain: In the 2020s, a Pentagon spokesperson named Susan Gough is said to have refused a request to widen her statement that there were no extraterrestrials so that it also covered "non-human intelligence," a broader term for any intelligent beings that are not human. The online researcher UAPGerb tells this without naming a source, saying the request came from someone using FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records. He suggests her refusal leaves room for beings that the narrow word "extraterrestrial" would not cover.
